newsitem.title: CHINA: SHANGHAI WAI GAOQIAO FREETRADE DEV CO TO SET FRN.
newsitem.headline: SHANGHAI WAI GAOQIAO FREETRADE DEV CO TO SET FRN.

text.p: Shanghai Wai Gaoqiao Freetrade Zone Development Co Ltd has mandated Deutsche Morgan Grenfell to arrange a US$50 million floating rate note issue, bankers said.

They said the facility has a final maturity of three years with a put and call option in year two. The issue is expected to be priced at par to float at 120 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, pricing is expected to be between 170 and 180 basis points over LIBOR, bankers said.
There is a maintenance of ownership clause, which states that the Shanghai Pudong New Area Administration will directly or indirectly own 51 percent in the issuer throughout the term of the issue.
General syndication is expected to commence this week.
